summary: Frontend-only automated E2E, persistence, edge-case, regression, responsive UI, and code review testing completed on the public URL. All requested Ahorro Automático calculations, toasts, history rendering, disabled states, current-month exclusion, deficit handling, and idempotency passed. Recurring auto-apply/toast, Comparison, Frequent Expenses, Notifications, and FAB hide-on-scroll regressions passed. One additional state-consistency defect was reproduced when deleting the selected goal, plus a minor expected-copy mismatch.

ui_bugs.issue: The expected copy is 'Primero crea una meta en la pestaña Metas', but the UI renders 'Primero crea una meta en la pestaña "Metas".' with added quotation marks and punctuation.

integration_issues.flow: Delete the goal currently selected as the automatic-savings destination
integration_issues.issue: Deleting the selected/last goal removes it from goals but leaves autoSaveEnabled=true and autoSaveGoalId pointing to the deleted ID. Settings then shows a disabled yet checked auto-save switch. Future processing silently returns without saving until the user creates and explicitly selects another goal.

action_items: When deleteGoal removes the goal referenced by autoSaveGoalId, clear autoSaveGoalId and turn off autoSaveEnabled so Settings cannot display a disabled checked switch or retain a dangling destination.
Align the no-goal guidance copy exactly with the requested text if exact product copy is required.
critical_code_review_comments: useFinance.deleteGoal only filters goals and does not reconcile autoSaveGoalId/autoSaveEnabled. This creates a dangling reference and makes applyPendingAutoSave silently no-op because its goal lookup fails. Update these fields atomically in the same setData callback when the deleted ID is the selected destination.
seed_data_creation: Used isolated localStorage fixtures under finance_tracker_data_v1 for two positive closed months, a deficit month, current-month-only activity, disabled/missing destination states, selected-goal deletion, recurring income, comparison values, frequent expenses, notification permission simulation, and a tall mobile recurring list. No backend or shared data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Browser calendar was 2026-08; positive fixture used 2026-06 leftover 5000 and 2026-07 leftover 10000. Goal became RD$15,000, toast and history passed, and a second reload was idempotent. A 2026-07 deficit was recorded with skipped=true/amount=0 while 2026-08 was excluded. All requested regressions passed, including the previously missing recurring mount toast. Retest selected-goal deletion by seeding g1 as enabled destination, deleting g1, and checking that both autoSaveEnabled and autoSaveGoalId are cleared.
rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: seed autoSaveEnabled=true, autoSaveGoalId='g1', and one goal g1; delete g1 in Metas; open Ajustes. Storage retains the stale destination and enabled flag, and the no-goal switch is disabled but checked. Root cause: deleteGoal updates only goals and has no atomic cascade for the auto-save configuration. The copy mismatch is literal text in SettingsPanel lines 140-142.
